integrity: The finite-state verifier uses exact rational arithmetic; its 98 assertions do not constitute proof of the infinite asymptotic. The proof provides a local limit argument and an explicit repair-error bound.
scientific_limitations: Independent uniform draws and M=floor(alpha n log n), fixed 0<alpha<1. Entry-conditioned coverage episodes only; no critical-window, nonuniform, multiple-episode, or higher-moment law. Historical priority remains open to independent review.
title: Exponential lifetime of complete sliding windows in a subcritical coupon collector
